module.name: XRFlow Softphone Hub
module.description: Free GPLv3+ companion for XRFlow Softphone on this FreePBX or PBXact: one-button enroll, WebRTC repair, fleet hooks, and Company Presence detect. Desktop seats are a separate commercial product. This module is not sold and does not require a Hub license key. Does not rewrite System Admin OpenVPN remotes.
module.changelog: *0.2.17* SMS DIDs assigned to the desk user are returned for the companion softphone device (97/98/99 plus the extension). *0.2.16* The PBX API app for Contacts uses scopes gql and rest. A comma between them was one invalid scope, so the directory token had neither GraphQL nor REST. *0.2.15* A home enroll includes the System Admin OpenVPN client. The desktop app turns VPN on from that profile. There is no separate .ovpn download. Remotes are not changed. *0.2.14* WebRTC tab can create an office profile and a home profile for the same extension. Each button issues its own enroll code. *0.2.13* WebRTC tab has Select all and Deselect all for the extension checkboxes. *0.2.12* The softphone device accepts several registrations on one extension (office without VPN and home with VPN). Each enroll code keeps its own VPN choice. *0.2.11* POST /xrflow-hub/v1/directory-avatars returns User Manager photos and emails for the desktop directory (SIP-secret auth). OAuth is not required. *0.2.10* Fleet heartbeat and desktop seat pool (org token). No xrflows.com password stored on the PBX. *0.2.9* Corporate logo is for every licensed Softphone. Hub stays free. No Enterprise gate. *0.2.8* Corporate logo for Enterprise Softphone seats (PNG 256px/144 DPI or square SVG). Not a desktop setting. *0.2.7* user-profile also matches User Manager by display name when default_extension is not 1016 *0.2.6* POST /xrflow-hub/v1/user-profile returns User Manager / voicemail email for Gravatar (SIP-secret auth) *0.2.5* Enroll payload includes Admin → API OAuth Client ID/secret (Contacts REST/GraphQL) *0.2.4* Enroll payload includes a dedicated Asterisk AMI user (xrflow-hub) for the desktop app *0.2.3* Public /xrflow-hub/enroll/{token} routes to PHP and redeems (Apache FallbackResource + unauth BMO load) *0.2.2* Enroll table, human WebRTC setup, per-desk OpenVPN, companion softphone device (desk phones unchanged) *0.2.1* Enroll/WebRTC list Core extensions (do not isset() BMO Core; users.extension not users.user) *0.2.0* Free GPLv3+ companion: no Hub license key, no trial, no HTTP 402. Desktop seats remain commercial. Sangoma GPG signing prep. *0.1.3* preinst probes PHP APIs (json_encode, curl_init, PDO mysql) — JSON is core in PHP 8, not php8.2-json *0.1.2* Debian Depends + preinst: refuse install unless FreePBX 17 and PHP curl/xml/mysql/mbstring are present *0.1.1* Enroll tokens (15 min, one-time) + POST /xrflow-hub/v1/enroll/redeem *0.1.0* Skeleton: license activate, 14-day trial, dashboard, REST 402 gate, WebRTC 488 checklist + template
